verdict.rationale: Hatchet is an orchestration platform with SDKs and an API, so an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence shows only static SDK reference pages, a CLI reference and an llms.txt file. Nothing documents an interactive API explorer or runnable examples, and the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec at any candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
